The Solution

Smart features that make a difference

From screening to interviews to assignments — HireOn runs the middle, so your team only spends time on the people worth meeting.

Every score points back to the moment it came from — the answer, the timestamp, the line of the rubric it was measured against. No verdict without a reason.

Screening, scheduling, reminders and scorecards run on their own. Your week goes back to talking to people instead of chasing calendars.

You set the rounds, the bar and the weighting — and you can change them mid-role. Candidates already in flight keep their scores.
